correctness.rationale: In a proper three-edge-coloured cubic graph, B/H form disjoint even cycles and R a perfect matching. In each factor cycle the selected internal R chord supplies a root v0; order e1,...,eℓ from B at v0, insert root R just after e1, and every other internal R chord from indices i<j (with j≥i+2) just after e_{i+1}. Every nonroot R is strictly before or strictly after both of its cycle edges, while the root word is B,R,H; red cross-cycle edges between ordered cycle blocks give first/last positions. Along nonroot B/H edges the relative B/H order alternates by vertex parity; edges incident to roots and all red edges are distinguished by R position. Every edge type is exhausted, and gap buckets give O(V+E) construction. The finite verifier is corroboration only.
residual_risks: The bundled verifier was inspected, not adopted as a universal proof; its logged counts were not treated as independent reproduction.
The theorem assumes the specified fixed proper colouring and at least one genuine internal chord per BH cycle; it is only sufficient.
